Rubaiya Esha finds a wider audience in Imran's new music video
results.description: Presenter and actress Rubaiya Esha is drawing wider attention after appearing in singer Imran Mahmudul's new music video, 'Sokhi Mon Bujhla Na', which has gathered millions of views on YouTube since its release on 14 November. The video is Esha's first. She said the project started with a casual conversation. "One day, Imran Mahmudul randomly asked me if I had ever wanted to work in a music video. I told him that I had always wanted my first music video to be with him," she said.

results.title: Marvel Studios Revives Cinematic Universe With Record-Breaking Spider-Man Release
